grading_policy.unit_rule: Exact canonical unit required for every field: percent or INR_crore. Display equivalents % and ₹ crore mean these same units. Do not normalize a wrong output unit during grading.
grading_policy.identity_rule: Company, requested financial concept, annual period or balance-sheet date, and consolidated basis must match. Numeric proximity alone is insufficient.
grading_policy.availability_rule: All seven values are supported in this case; omission or unavailable is a failure for that field.
grading_policy.citation_rule: Each value must cite supplied evidence that supports the concept, basis, period, sign and value, including components of an aggregation.
grading_policy.case_pass: All seven requested facts must pass identity, number, unit and evidence checks. The unit match requirement is 100%.
